inputs: company/org_registry.yaml, permissions.yaml and the two schema files
A non-empty list of required capability names
A task assignment or handoff mapping to validate
invariants: Capability matching is exact and deterministic: active before dormant, then fewest unrelated capabilities, then employee id.
match_capabilities explains every employee's result, not only the winners.
No LLM call, no network, no third-party dependency - standard library only.
A handoff or contract with no_subagents not exactly true is rejected (rule 2).
Resolved context is reused only while its source digest matches: a stale entry is evicted, never returned, and a miss is preferred to stale evidence.
Compressed context is reversible against its canonical source or refused; reuse and compression carry a unit's authority through and never raise it.
outputs: CompanyConfig holding the four parsed contracts
RoutingResult with one EmployeeMatch per employee, eligible or not
TaskAssignment and HandoffArtifact, or ValidationError listing every issue
A reference-only ContextManifest and inspectable ContextPlan
Append-only efficiency records and deterministic benchmark comparisons
purpose: Loads bootstrap contracts, routes tasks, assembles bounded capsule-backed context with no LLM call, carries compact handoffs, and measures execution context efficiency without fabricating provider data.
risks: Runtime intentionally invokes validation; validation must remain independent of runtime implementation modules.
Owned by the Codex workstream: another session may be editing it concurrently.
